main_text.p: muni Judicibus & Principibus populi, etiam in sacris, ut recte observat Toftatus & Petrus de Marca ex Maimonide, opere de concordia Imperii & sacerdotii; ubi vult parem rationem esse aut esse debere sub œconomia Evangelica. Sed de hisce fusius in opere ipso.

Porro, ut finem tandem imponam huic benè longæ Admonitioni, confido, nisi majorem mei quam par est fiduciam habeam, ut suæ quisque inventioni favet, me longè utilissimam veritatem à nemine hactenus patefactam, hoc opere evulgasse: &, si in exequenda hac causa, laboravi infirmitate ingenii, orationis & eruditionis, me tamen istius causæ Jugulum vidisse & pressisse; & si non jugulavi Papam, saltem locum mon-

page.notes: Printed text is in the main text. The line "muni Judicibus" begins mid-word from the previous page. The word "Admonitio." is the running head. The word "mon-" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page. Some words are slightly blurred by stains (e.g. "Jugulum", "patefactam") but were legible.
